Direct substitution yields the quartic equation, an explicit rational inverse proves birationality, a complete Jacobian case split proves the singular locus is exactly \([1:0:0]\), and local orders \(2\) and \(7\) give type \(A_6\). The homogeneous Wronskian factors as \(-4s^3(s^3+2t^3)^2\), whose zeros are exactly the four cusp parameters.
